speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them spell it. The post will hold a title, and a title is as much as the town owes a play before it has paid.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: They have named it before they have seen it. I have hung worse news, and later.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Two kings on one post, and neither of them me. I can live as far as Shoreditch on that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Live, then. Theirs is the tall one, who never doubts. Ours is the one I have been teaching to do nothing else, and the teaching is not for a gate.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You and your teaching. I am only passing a sermon, Master Shakespeare, the way a sober man passes one.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Pass it. The plot is at the Theatre. The post has done what a post does, which is to talk to people who are not us.

speaker: (the carter)
text: Soon enough to say it. A king play. Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has said it twice. The town will finish the sentence without any help from a player.
